versions.subject: fix: merge rules and update detection
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\rdrleakdiag.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: RdrLeakDiag.exe
selection_cli_dump:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'fullmemdmp'
        - '/memdmp'
        - '-memdmp'
selection_cli_output:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -o '
        - ' /o '
selection_cli_process:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -p '
        - ' /p '
condition: all of selection_cli_* or (selection_img and selection_cli_dump)
versions.spl: (CommandLine IN ("*fullmemdmp*", "*/memdmp*", "*-memdmp*") CommandLine IN ("* -o *", "* /o *") CommandLine IN ("* -p *", "* /p *")) OR (Image="*\\rdrleakdiag.exe" OR OriginalFileName="RdrLeakDiag.exe" CommandLine IN ("*fullmemdmp*", "*/memdmp*", "*-memdmp*"))
